{{Top}}
The '''Bpr-99 fusion reactor''' was a type of [[Power core/Legends|power core]] that was manufactured by [[MPS/Legends|MPS]].

==History==
It was installed in standard models of the popular [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]], which was utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
